title: Open Psychology Interactives lesson
description: A lesson a lecturer composes from catalogue activities, notes and questions. The same object travels in a student link, sits in data/lessons/ as a curated lesson, and would be what a later server stores. Nothing in it names a person, a subject or a platform. The limits here are mirrored in assets/product/lesson.js and scripts/check-lessons.py.

id.description: Only for curated lessons under data/lessons/; equals the file name without .json.

intro.description: Shown to the student before the first step. Markdown, rendered without raw HTML.

author.description: Optional. How the lesson is signed for the student, for example a module code.

setting.description: Only for curated lessons: the teaching setting the sequence was written for.

summary.description: Only for curated lessons: one or two sentences for a listing.
